about: #4463: the det ports `proof_sweep.py --det-only` does not prove, each with the issue that owns it. A two-way ratchet: CI fails on a port not listed here that is not proven, and on a listed port that is now proven. When a fix lands, run `python tests/tools/proof_sweep.py --det-only --skip-db2 --work DIR --update-baseline` and commit the shortened file; a new entry is only ever added by hand, with its true cause.

cbsa-crecust.why: CRECUST's CEEDAYS passes a 10-byte picture over an 8-byte 'YYYYMMDD' date: the picture's 2 extra bytes are the storage after the item, which z/OS would read as picture text. Only an all-BLANK picture tail is assumed ignored (oracle_assumptions.md L1, owner decision 2026-10-14), so the oracle refuses by name ('CEEDAYS: picture not modelled'); the committed create-customer and born-in-the-future scenarios reach it, so the case is refused and the port stays unproven. Also open: X18 (the child schedule is ASSUMED). L4 is settled (FC is the 12-byte token). The scenario born-before-1601 ends before CEEDAYS and runs equal but reaches 13 of 37 paragraphs, so it is not a proof.

mortgage-mpmt.why: IBM DBB EPSMPMT computes its payment through a COMP-1 item in hexadecimal floating point on z/OS, truncated decimal on GnuCOBOL. The det runtime models HFP since #4271 slice 1 (its interest COMPUTE translates), but the payment's (1 + C) ** N, N with decimal places, is a floating-point exponentiation IBM does not document bit for bit: a named hole (oracle_assumptions.md C6; its CBL NUMPROC(MIG) is modelled, C5). The dead-code FUNCTION ANNUITY (line 144) is the second: IBM defines the formula, arg-1 / (1 - (1 + arg-1) ** -arg-2), but not the bits of the power or of the result, so it is refused by name with that reason (not modelled). Two holes before and after #4271's last slice; the callers mortgage-csmrt and mortgage-cmort keep theirs

mortgage-csmrt.why: EPSCSMRT CALLs EPSMPMT, which has holes (line 125: (1 + C) ** N floating-point exponentiation, oracle_assumptions.md C6; line 144: FUNCTION ANNUITY, dead code). The case's five validation-path scenarios run equal on both sides and never reach them, but a program is not proven while a program it CALLs has holes, whichever scenarios were written (owner decision 2026-10-11): the proof passes, the port stays unproven until EPSMPMT's holes are closed (#4271).

cbsa-bnk1ccs.why: Two named holes (the java-facade answer of its LENGTH(248) RETURN over a 5-byte WS-COMM-AREA is read since #5089: the bytes past the record are dropped as undefined). (1) It LINKs CRECUST, whose CEEDAYS call the oracle refuses (oracle_assumptions.md L1, #4952): no scenario creates a customer (every scenario that reaches CRECUST is born in 1500, which CRECUST refuses before CEEDAYS), so the successful create is not covered. (2) CRECUST's async credit check schedule is ASSUMED (X18), and its FC is 8 bytes where LE writes 12 (L4). The runTask proof is equal on all 83 scenarios and 33 of 33 paragraphs.

zecs-zecs003.why: ZECS003 reads and deletes records of the instance's files ZC##FILE and ZC##KEY, named at run time from EIBTRNID; zECS defines them in IDCAMS jobs with install placeholders (@ECS_HLQ@ ...) in the dataset names, so no case can state their records and the generated project stores no such file: the Java side refuses the READ of ZC01FILE by name ('Hole: CICS file ZC01FILE: the program names no file the generated project stores') where GnuCOBOL answers FILENOTFOUND. The scenarios cover the COMMAREA, the document template, the WEB PARSE / OPEN / CONVERSE / CLOSE replication and the WEB SEND on the COBOL side; the expired-record browse and 3100-DELETE are not covered and not proven.

mortgage-cmort.why: EPSCMORT's ENTER path LINKs EPSCSMRT (PROGRAM from a variable), which CALLs EPSMPMT, which has holes (line 125: (1 + C) ** N floating-point exponentiation, oracle_assumptions.md C6; line 144: FUNCTION ANNUITY, dead code). The case's 16 scenarios run equal on both sides (runTask and java-facade) and the ENTER / WHEN OTHER scenarios stay on EPSMPMT's validation paths, but a program is not proven while a program it LINKs or CALLs has holes, whichever scenarios were written (owner decision 2026-10-11, mainframe-evidence-policy.md 4): the proof passes, the port stays unproven until EPSMPMT's holes are closed (#4271).
